joinRoomInvite.body: function joinRoomInvite(m){let room=socialRoomCode(m?.room);if(!room)return toast('That room invite is invalid.');$('modal').classList.add('h');$('room').classList.remove('h');$('jb').classList.remove('h');$('jc').value=room;$('join').click();setTimeout(()=>$('con').click(),100)}
